Packages.Name: Microsoft Sysinternals Suite
Packages.Note: Microsoft troubleshooting suite including Process Monitor, Process Explorer, TCPView, Sigcheck, Autoruns, PsPing, PendMoves, and other diagnostics. Individual tools can make privileged changes and remain operator-invoked.

Packages.Name: Windows Packet Monitor (Pktmon)
Packages.Note: In-box Windows network diagnostic for packet capture, filtering, counters, and drop detection. No installer is needed; capture is an explicit operator-authorized workflow and AV Workstation Toolkit does not execute Pktmon.

Packages.Name: Milan Manager
Packages.Note: Free brand-neutral Milan-AVB configuration and monitoring tool supported by L-Acoustics and d&b audiotechnik; review Npcap/driver requirements before field deployment.

Packages.Name: Packet Sender
Packages.Note: Free TCP, UDP, SSL/TLS, DTLS, and HTTP client/server test utility with portable and installed Windows builds. Listener and traffic-generation modes require authorization for the target network.

Packages.Name: NDI Tools
Packages.Note: Official NDI utility suite including Discovery, Access Manager, Router, Test Patterns, Studio Monitor, Webcam Input, Screen Capture, Bridge, and plugins. NDI Analysis is a separate utility and NDI Remote has been discontinued. Some suite components expose sources, listeners, or services; commercial-use terms require vendor review.

Packages.Name: NDI Analysis
Packages.Note: Separate Windows command-line utility for NDI network analysis and statistics. It is not included in the standard NDI Tools launcher and remains a non-executable awareness record.

Packages.Name: NDI Remote (discontinued)
Packages.Note: Discontinued NDI remote-contribution service. The service is offline and this quarantined historical record provides no install or download action.

Verification.QuarantineReason: The vendor documents NDI Remote as discontinued and its service as offline.

Packages.Name: NETGEAR Engage Controller
Packages.Note: Portable AV-network switch configuration and firmware utility; use only on authorized networks and approved switch fleets.

Packages.Name: NEXO NS-1
Packages.Note: NEXO sound-system configuration and prediction software; use current manufacturer data for the target loudspeaker system.

Packages.Name: NEXO NeMo
Packages.Note: NEXO amplifier and device monitoring/control software; maintain firmware and project compatibility.

Packages.Name: NovaStar NovaLCT
Packages.Note: Widely used LED display configuration and calibration tool; installer may add serial drivers and should be project-pinned.

Packages.Name: NovaStar SmartLCT
Packages.Note: LED screen configuration and mapping software for supported NovaStar systems; maintain controller and project compatibility.

Packages.Name: NovaStar ViPlex Express
Packages.Note: Content publishing and player-management software for NovaStar asynchronous signage systems.

Packages.Name: NovaStar VMP
Packages.Note: COEX control-system configuration and management software; version selection is tied to the processor and firmware family.

VersionCoupling.Notes: Use the VMP release supported by the target COEX controller and firmware.

Packages.Name: Nureva App
Packages.Note: Current setup, configuration, and firmware application for Nureva systems; succeeds the retired Console client workflow.

Packages.Name: Nureva Console
Packages.Note: Cloud monitoring and management service included with Nureva systems; not a local workstation installer.

Packages.Name: Nureva Console Client
Packages.Note: End-of-life client retained only for existing systems; downloads were removed after April 19, 2026 and Nureva App is the replacement.

Packages.Name: Obsidian ONYX
Packages.Note: Windows lighting-control software with one free Art-Net/sACN universe and hardware or USB-key licensing for larger systems; network output and remote features require approval.

Packages.Name: OBS Studio
Packages.Note: Open-source recording and live-streaming application. Plugins, virtual-camera use, capture drivers, and listening services must be evaluated for the intended workstation role.

Packages.Name: Open Sound Meter
Packages.Note: High-value open-source dual-channel audio measurement and commissioning utility; validate the audio interface and calibration chain before field use.

Packages.Name: Panasonic Media Production Suite
Packages.Note: Current Panasonic ProAV camera software platform; paid plug-ins and firmware operations remain project-specific.

Packages.Name: Panasonic EasyIP Setup Tool Plus
Packages.Note: Transition awareness: functionality is integrated into Media Production Suite; retain standalone use only where current project guidance permits.

Packages.Name: Panasonic PTZ Virtual USB Driver
Packages.Note: Virtual USB camera driver; it changes system drivers and should be installed only for an identified Panasonic PTZ workflow.

Packages.Name: Panasonic PTZ Control Center
Packages.Note: Transition awareness: future updates are delivered through Media Production Suite; keep standalone versions only for compatibility.

Packages.Name: Panasonic Geometry Manager Pro
Packages.Note: Professional projector geometry, warping, and blending software; paid features and model support are project-specific.

Packages.Name: PingPlotter
Packages.Note: Continuous latency, route, and packet-loss visualization for network troubleshooting. Paid and trial editions differ; monitoring targets must be authorized.

Packages.Name: Planar WallDirector OS
Packages.Note: Web-based management application delivered with Planar WallDirector controllers for source layouts, video-wall configuration, health monitoring, alerts, and permissions. It is embedded system awareness, not a Windows installer.

Packages.Name: Powersoft ArmoníaPlus
Packages.Note: Current Powersoft amplifier design, control, monitoring, and firmware platform; project and device compatibility govern updates.

Packages.Name: Professional Wireless Systems IAS
Packages.Note: Established intermodulation-analysis application retained for workflows and files that require it; current status and acquisition remain explicitly unverified.

Packages.Name: QLC+
Packages.Note: Open-source cross-platform lighting console with DMX, Art-Net, sACN, OSC, MIDI, scripting, and optional web control. Output and listener functions require explicit network approval.

Packages.Name: Q-SYS UCI Viewer
Packages.Note: Standalone UCI client; keep its major/minor release aligned with the target Q-SYS design and Core firmware.

Packages.Name: Attero Tech unIFY Control Panel
Packages.Note: Configuration and firmware utility for supported Attero Tech networked-audio endpoints.

Packages.Name: Q-SYS MP Install
Packages.Note: Commissioning utility associated with Q-SYS MP-series systems; obtain only when that equipment is in scope.

Packages.Name: Q-SYS Reflect
Packages.Note: Cloud monitoring and management awareness; this is not modeled as a local Windows installer.

Packages.Name: Rane Halogen
Packages.Note: Rane HAL DSP design and commissioning software; maintain project and hardware firmware compatibility.

Packages.Name: Rational Acoustics Smaart Suite
Packages.Note: Full licensed Smaart acoustic measurement suite; license activation, calibrated hardware, and trained operating practice are prerequisites.

Packages.Name: Rational Acoustics Smaart RT
Packages.Note: Licensed Smaart real-time measurement edition; select only when its feature set matches the commissioning role.

Packages.Name: Rational Acoustics Smaart LE
Packages.Note: Licensed streamlined Smaart edition; choose based on documented measurement needs rather than installing every Smaart edition.

Packages.Name: Rational Acoustics Smaart SPL
Packages.Note: Dedicated licensed SPL monitoring edition; logging, microphone calibration, and compliance procedures remain separate operational controls.

Packages.Name: Rational Acoustics Smaart Data Modeler
Packages.Note: Licensed Smaart data-modeling application; install for loudspeaker/data analysis roles rather than general field use.

Packages.Name: RealTerm
Packages.Note: Engineering terminal for binary serial streams, RS-485, Winsock/Telnet, capture, and automation. Retain for difficult installed-base protocol work; current support status is not asserted.

Packages.Name: Resolume Arena
Packages.Note: Live visual, projection-mapping, and multi-output media-server software; project files, plugins, capture drivers, and output licensing must be validated before show use.

Packages.Name: Resolume Avenue
Packages.Note: Live visual performance software; keep show files, plugins, capture drivers, and the licensed feature set aligned with the production environment.

Packages.Name: Resolume Wire
Packages.Note: Node-based patching environment for Resolume effects, sources, and mixers; plugin compatibility follows the target Resolume release.

Packages.Name: ClearWaves RF Spectrum Analyzer Software
Packages.Note: Licensed RF spectrum and coordination software whose license is associated with RF Explorer hardware.

Packages.Name: Riedel Director
Packages.Note: Artist matrix configuration and control software; account access and matrix firmware compatibility are project-specific.

VersionCoupling.Notes: Confirm Director and Artist platform firmware compatibility before service.

Packages.Name: Riedel Bolero Web Interface
Packages.Note: Embedded Bolero configuration interface awareness; this is not a downloadable Windows application.

Packages.Name: Room EQ Wizard
Packages.Note: Widely used acoustic measurement and analysis application; verify calibration, Java/runtime requirements, and commercial-use support needs.

Packages.Name: Ross DashBoard
Packages.Note: Free cross-platform control, monitoring, CustomPanel, and workflow application for Ross and openGear/DashBoard Connect ecosystems. Network control must remain within the authorized production environment.

Packages.Name: Ross Platform Manager
Packages.Note: Central web platform for hosting DashBoard panels, software-license management, monitoring, logging, and fleet consistency. Treat as enterprise server infrastructure rather than a routine workstation app.

Packages.Name: RTS NEO Intercom Management Suite
Packages.Note: Next-generation RTS configuration and management suite for supported OMNEO matrix and partyline systems.

Packages.Name: RTS AZedit
Packages.Note: RTS matrix configuration, monitoring, and firmware tool; current suite delivery coexists with legacy standalone labels.

Packages.Name: RTS IPedit
Packages.Note: Windows configuration application for RTS OMNEO and RVON devices; use the suite release supported by the matrix system.

Packages.Name: RTS OMNEO Suite
Packages.Note: Legacy suite bundle containing DNS-SD service, firmware tools, USB drivers, AZedit, and IPedit; install only as a release-matched set for existing systems.

Packages.Name: RTS VLink
Packages.Note: Licensed software intercom platform and client; server, client, and matrix integration roles must be designed and licensed separately.

Packages.Name: sACNView
Packages.Note: Free protocol analyzer, monitor, transmitter, snapshot, and PCAP-playback utility for ANSI E1.31 sACN. Transmit and listen functions must be used only on an authorized lighting network.

Packages.Name: Samsung MagicINFO Author
Packages.Note: Samsung digital-signage content authoring application; project and player compatibility govern deployment.

Packages.Name: Samsung MagicINFO Server
Packages.Note: Server infrastructure for MagicINFO signage fleets; never place it in the ordinary workstation baseline.

Packages.Name: Samsung VXT
Packages.Note: Cloud-native signage content and device-management awareness; subscription and tenant access are separate from local installation.

Packages.Name: Samsung Color Expert LED
Packages.Note: Samsung LED display calibration and color-management software; system authorization is obtained through a Samsung account manager.

Packages.Name: ScreenBeam CMS Enterprise
Packages.Note: Windows Server or VM service for centralized ScreenBeam management; never treat as an ordinary workstation app.

Packages.Name: Sennheiser Transmitter Manager
Packages.Note: Legacy transmitter configuration utility retained for installed-base awareness; no current official download was verified.

Packages.Name: Sennheiser Spectera LINKDESK
Packages.Note: Transition awareness: LINKDESK is being superseded by Spectera WebUI and SoundBase; preserve only for compatible Spectera firmware.

VersionCoupling.Notes: LINKDESK 1.6.0 is incompatible with Spectera firmware newer than 1.3.0; use current vendor guidance.

Packages.Name: Sharp NEC NaViSet Administrator 2
Packages.Note: Display and projector asset management, control, and monitoring utility; network and service scope require approval.

Packages.Name: Shure IntelliMix Room
Packages.Note: Licensed software DSP for conferencing PCs; audio-driver, service, entitlement, and room-design impacts require deliberate approval.

Packages.Name: Shure SystemOn
Packages.Note: Server-oriented Shure monitoring and management software; do not place it in an ordinary technician workstation baseline.

Packages.Name: Sony RM-IP Setup Tool
Packages.Note: IP addressing and setup utility for supported Sony professional remote cameras and controllers.

Packages.Name: SoundBase SE
Packages.Note: Free cloud RF coordination and project-management tier; device-control scope and account use should match the project.

Packages.Name: SoundBase Pro Desktop
Packages.Note: Licensed native RF coordination, offline project, spectrum, and hardware-control application; network and cloud-sync policy require review.

Packages.Name: vMix
Packages.Note: Windows live-production, recording, streaming, replay, and network-video application. It offers both perpetual and subscription licensing and can expose streaming and remote-production services.

Packages.Name: Symetrix Composer
Packages.Note: Primary Symetrix DSP design, control, and commissioning environment for supported systems.

Packages.Name: Symetrix SymVue
Packages.Note: Operator control application generated from Composer projects; runtime deployment remains project-specific.

VersionCoupling.Notes: Use the SymVue runtime generated and supported by the corresponding Composer project.

Packages.Name: Symetrix Jupiter
Packages.Note: Supported installed-base software with major development discontinued; choose only for Jupiter hardware service.

Packages.Name: SymNet Designer
Packages.Note: Legacy Symetrix design environment obtainable only through support when required for an installed system.

Packages.Name: Tera Term
Packages.Note: Free terminal emulator supporting serial, Telnet, SSH, file transfer, and scripting. Portable and installer builds are available from the signed project release page.

Packages.Name: Unity Intercom
Packages.Note: Licensed software intercom server and clients; network listeners and remote access require an approved architecture.

Packages.Name: USB Device Tree Viewer
Packages.Note: Free portable USB topology and descriptor diagnostic utility with x64, x86, and Arm64 builds; because it is portable, absence from uninstall registry is not evidence of absence.

Packages.Name: Vaddio Deployment Tool
Packages.Note: Free device discovery, configuration, and firmware deployment utility for supported Vaddio equipment.

Packages.Name: Vaddio Dante Interface Application
Packages.Note: Product-specific Dante interface utility; verify supported Vaddio hardware before obtaining it.

Packages.Name: Vaddio Loader
Packages.Note: Legacy or product-specific Vaddio firmware loader; use only when current vendor instructions explicitly require it.

Packages.Name: Wisycom Manager
Packages.Note: Wireless system configuration, coordination, monitoring, and firmware utility with optional USB drivers and network services.

Packages.Name: WolfVision vSolution Link Pro
Packages.Note: Free and premium remote management, firmware, inventory, and configuration platform for WolfVision devices; server mode exposes services.

Packages.Name: Xilica Designer
Packages.Note: Primary Xilica DSP and control design environment for supported systems.

Packages.Name: Xilica XTouch
Packages.Note: Xilica control-interface application for supported Designer projects and devices.

Packages.Name: Xilica XConsole
Packages.Note: Legacy Xilica configuration application retained for installed systems not supported by current Designer workflows.

Packages.Name: Xilica XLink
Packages.Note: Legacy Xilica utility awareness; preserve only for a documented installed-system requirement.

Packages.Name: Yamaha ProVisionaire Design
Packages.Note: Current Yamaha system design and DSP configuration platform; preserve project and device-firmware compatibility.

Packages.Name: Yamaha ProVisionaire Control PLUS
Packages.Note: Custom-control interface authoring software for supported Yamaha systems; maintain version alignment with deployed projects.

Packages.Name: Yamaha ProVisionaire Kiosk
Packages.Note: Runtime control application for ProVisionaire projects; install only on an approved operator workstation or appliance.

Packages.Name: Yamaha ProVisionaire Edge
Packages.Note: Monitoring and management component for supported Yamaha systems; listener and service behavior require deployment review.

Packages.Name: Yealink USB Connect
Packages.Note: Local configuration, diagnostics, and firmware utility for supported Yealink USB devices.

Packages.Name: Yealink Device Management Platform
Packages.Note: On-premises device-management platform awareness; server services and listeners exclude it from ordinary workstation deployment.

Packages.Name: Yealink Management Cloud Service
Packages.Note: Cloud device-management awareness; tenant access and subscription are not a local software deployment concern.

Packages.Name: ZeeVee ZyPer Management Platform / MaestroZ
Packages.Note: Embedded or VM management platform and browser UI for ZeeVee ZyPer endpoints. It is infrastructure awareness, not a Windows workstation application; firmware ordering and endpoint generation must be verified before updates.
